title: Perplexity, checked
statement_md:
Write `perplexity(log_probs)` returning the perplexity of a sequence of natural-log token probabilities: `exp(-mean(log_probs))`.

- raise `ValueError` for an empty sequence
- raise `ValueError` if any log-probability is positive
- return a `float`

A certain token has log-probability `0`; a uniform choice over ten tokens has `-log(10)`.
